project.name: gj-pf4j-security
project.description:
gj.spring.pf4j — Pluggable Authentication for Plugin Controllers.
Two-layer provider API: AbstractPluginAuthenticationProvider (simple, single-strategy) and IPluginAuthenticationProvider (advanced, multi-provider routing with supports()). Strategy-driven provider chain: AtLeastOneSuccessfulStrategy (default) and FirstSuccessfulStrategy, both pluggable via AuthenticationStrategy bean override.
Dual-stack auth filters: PluginDelegatingAuthFilter (MVC Servlet) and PluginDelegatingAuthWebFilter (WebFlux Reactive). Shared provider chain execution engine (AuthChainExecutor) for consistent behavior across both stacks.
Seven-position filter extension framework: FIRST, SESSION_RESTORE, FORM_LOGIN, AUTHENTICATION (framework-reserved), ANONYMOUS, PRE_AUTHORIZE, LAST — each with Servlet and WebFlux interfaces, registered via lifecycle PluginResourceRegistrar. Three-tier host configuration: global on/off, per-position allowlist, per-plugin authorization — all disabled by default.
Control-flow exceptions: PluginAuthChallenge (OAuth2/SAML redirect, non-error), PluginBadCredentialsException (client fault), PluginAuthServiceException (server fault). Authentication events (PluginAuthenticationSuccessEvent / FailureEvent) for host audit and alerting integration.
